meta.title: Buka Workers & Workflows
meta.description: Workers with a defined role plus persistent workflows with a job board. A worker is an individual: an agent with its own directory, AGENTS.md, project skills and a one-sentence responsibility, running as a DSH session, or a robot, a fixed program (v1 ships clock). A workflow is a position graph; a job is one workflow plus one input, and every job gets a board. Tasks are added by running positions at any time, dispatched only along drawn channels, made ready through explicit dependencies, and claimed automatically by workers; a person acts on a human task directly and submitting claims it for them, while an assistant worker named by its identifier can handle it on their behalf. A single Workflow preset both designs and saves workflows and builds or renames workers. A workflow or job that references a deleted worker derives an unavailable state: it cannot start or dispatch until an existing worker is bound again; deleted workers show a placeholder avatar and Deleted in history.
